title: 第二十二章 出去也没地方去
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
侯紫搓了搓手指，边走边跟沈君壁说，“这种情况我熟呀，这跟岳州城荒郊一点区别都没有，我本以为修士总是高高在上的，结果这里简直比凡间炼狱还惨。”

    “是啊，我出身沈家，虽然没灵根，但起码都没吃过苦头，三年来在汉口镇码头，见了太多凡间疾苦，却没发觉这里竟然比凡间还苦，这些人怎么不出去呢？”沈君壁感慨着。

    “凡间灵气稀薄，这里起码能蹭点灵气，出去的话大概就像溺水一样吧，呼吸都困难，所以只能在这里想办法找条出路。”侯紫唏嘘着。

    “应该就是这样吧。”沈君壁也很无语。

    话音刚落，巷口传来脚步声。不是一个人的脚步声，是三个人。刚才那个眼神像饿狼的散修走在最前面，身后跟着两个同样衣衫褴褛的同伴。一个手里攥着根锈迹斑斑的铁棍，另一个空着手，但拳头上缠着破布，破布上渗着暗褐色的血渍——不知道是他自己的还是别人的。

    为首的散修在两人面前三步远的地方站定。他比刚才在巷口蹲着时看起来更瘦，颧骨高耸，眼窝深陷，但那双眼睛亮得瘆人。是饿到极点之后反而亢奋起来的亮。

    “新来的。”他开口了，声音沙哑得像砂纸磨石头，“懂规矩吗？”

    侯紫把手从袖子里抽出来，嘿嘿一笑：“什么规矩？”

    “进贫民窟，交保护费。”那散修伸出三根手指，“一人五颗下品灵石。交了，保你们在贫民窟平安。不交——”他身后的两个同伴往前逼了一步。

    “不交会怎样？”侯紫的语气还是笑嘻嘻的。

    “不交，你们身上那两块新令牌，今晚就会出现在别人手里。”那散修舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，“登记处只认证不认人。令牌在谁手里，谁就是令牌的主人。”

    侯紫和沈君壁对视一眼。这人知道他们刚办了新令牌，说明他从登记处门口就盯上他们了。老太太看人下菜碟，贫民窟的散修守在登记处门口等着宰新人——这条产业链，从登记处窗口到贫民窟巷口，一气呵成。

    “五颗灵石。”侯紫咂了咂嘴，“太多了。我们刚交完登记费，兜里就剩几颗碎灵石。这样，一颗，交个朋友。”

    “一颗？”那散修愣了一下，然后笑了。是那种被气笑的、不敢相信自己耳朵的笑。他身后的两个同伴也笑了，铁棍在石墙上敲了一下，发出沉闷的响声。“你当这是菜市场讨价还价？”

    “菜市场讨价还价还能挑拣菜叶子，你这儿连菜叶子都没有，就一句‘保平安’的空话，一颗灵石我都嫌贵。”侯紫把手张开，五根手指在空中晃了晃，“再说了，你开口要五颗，自己留几颗？两颗给你这两个兄弟一人一颗，你自己赚多少？三颗？你一个领头的，比手下多赚两颗，这买卖干得可不地道。”
content_en:
Hou Zi rubbed his fingers and said to Shen Junbi as he walked, "I am familiar with this situation. It is no different from the deserted suburbs of Yuezhou City. I thought the monks were always aloof, but it turned out that this place is worse than the mortal hell."

"Yes, I was born in the Shen family. Although I have no spiritual roots, at least I have never suffered. In the past three years at the dock in Hankou Town, I have seen too much suffering in the world, but I didn't realize that it is even worse than the world. Why don't these people go out?" Shen Junbi sighed.

"The spiritual energy in the mortal world is thin. At least I can get some spiritual energy here. If I go out, it will probably be like drowning. It will be difficult to breathe, so I can only find a way out here." Hou Zi lamented.

"That should be it." Shen Junbi was also speechless.

As soon as he finished speaking, footsteps came from the alley.The footsteps were not of one person, but of three people.The casual cultivator with the hungry wolf-like eyes just now walked at the front, followed by two companions who were also in ragged clothes.One hand was holding a rusty iron rod, and the other was empty-handed, but his fist was wrapped in a rag, and there were dark brown blood stains on the rag - I don't know if it was his own or someone else's.

The leader of the casual cultivators stood three steps away from the two of them.He looked thinner than when he was squatting in the alley just now, with high cheekbones and sunken eye sockets, but his eyes were so bright that it was scary.It was Liang who became excited after being extremely hungry.

"New here." He spoke, his voice hoarse like sandpaper grinding stone, "Do you understand the rules?"

Hou Zi took his hands out of his sleeves and smiled: "What are the rules?"

"Enter the slums and pay the protection fee." The casual cultivator stretched out three fingers and said, "Five low-grade spiritual stones per person. If you pay, I will keep you safe in the slums. If you don't pay -" the two companions behind him took a step forward.

"What will happen if we don't make friends?" Hou Zi's tone was still smiling.

"If you don't hand it over, the two new tokens you are carrying will appear in the hands of others tonight." The casual cultivator licked his chapped lips, "The registration office only authenticates and does not recognize the person. Whoever has the token is the owner of the token."

Hou Zi and Shen Junbi looked at each other.This man knew that they had just obtained new tokens, which meant that he had been targeting them from the entrance of the registration office.The old lady watches the dishes being served, and the monks from the slums wait at the entrance of the registration office, waiting to kill the newcomers - this industry chain runs smoothly from the window of the registration office to the entrance of the slum alley.

"Five spirit stones." Hou Zi smacked his lips, "Too many. We just paid the registration fee, and there are only a few broken spirit stones left in our pockets. In this way, one can make a friend."

"One?" The casual cultivator was stunned for a moment, then smiled.It's the kind of laugh that makes you laugh in anger and you can't believe your ears.The two companions behind him also laughed, and the iron rod knocked on the stone wall, making a dull sound."Do you think this is haggling at the vegetable market?"

"You can still pick vegetable leaves while bargaining at the vegetable market. You don't even have vegetable leaves here. It's just an empty talk about 'safeguarding peace'. Even a spiritual stone is too expensive for me." Hou Zi opened his hands and waved five fingers in the air. "Besides, you asked for five, how many do you keep for yourself? Two for each of your two brothers. How much do you earn? Three? You are the leader, and you earn two more than your subordinates. This business is not authentic."
